about: A child the instrument starts gets the parent's module-loading flags and never an eval: the measured copy's migrate (cli/measure.ts), the extension's measure (fold/extension.ts) and the observer that runs behind a fold (fold/observed.ts) take host/capsule.ts's childFlags, which drops -e, --eval, -p, --print and --input-type with the code they carry, as the capsule host and the rebirth already do.
